entries.text: python -m benchbox.utils.host_lock run --guard watches the command's process tree and stops it (exit 79) when its summed physical footprint passes BENCHBOX_HEAVY_MEMORY_BUDGET_GIB, memory pressure turns critical, or free disk drops below BENCHBOX_HEAVY_KILL_FREE_DISK_GIB; BENCHBOX_HEAVY_WATCHDOG=warn reports only and off disables it.
